# Getting Started with Kortix

Welcome to Kortix! This guide will help you set up your account and start building with AI.

## Prerequisites

- A Kortix account (sign up at kortix.ai)
- A Git repository to connect

## Step 1: Create Your Account

1. Go to [kortix.ai/auth/signup](https://kortix.ai/auth/signup)
2. Sign up with your email or GitHub
3. Verify your email address

## Step 2: Connect Your Repository

1. Navigate to Settings > Repositories
2. Click "Connect Repository"
3. Select your Git provider (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)
4. Authorize Kortix to access your repositories

## Step 3: Start Building

1. Open your connected project
2. Use the AI assistant to describe what you want to build
3. Review and apply the generated code

## Next Steps

- [Learn about AI Agents](/docs/agents)
- [Explore the API](/docs/api)
- [Join our Discord community](https://discord.gg/kortix)

# Welcome to Kortix

We're thrilled to announce the launch of Kortix, an AI-powered development platform designed to help you build software faster than ever before.

## What is Kortix?

Kortix is your AI development partner. It understands your codebase, follows your patterns, and helps you write production-ready code in seconds.

### Key Features

- **Intelligent Code Generation** - Describe what you want in natural language
- **Smart Debugging** - AI-powered bug detection and fixes
- **Real-time Collaboration** - Work with your team seamlessly
- **One-Click Deploy** - Ship to production instantly

## Getting Started

Getting started with Kortix is easy:

1. Sign up for a free account
2. Connect your repository
3. Start building with AI
